name: cc-plugins
description: Shared plugins: git workflow commands, release and deploy tooling, and more

plugins.name: git-commands
plugins.description: Git workflow commands for watching PR CI checks, fixing failures, and merging PRs

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Software release commands for creating semver-tagged releases with changelog generation and GoReleaser

plugins.name: release-workflows
plugins.description: Convention-based release commands: cut a semver release using a repo's update-version.sh, and bootstrap new repos onto the convention with templates for update-version scripts, release.yml jobs, RELEASING.md, and a shared release-bot GitHub App

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deploy commands for creating date-based releases that trigger Docker image builds and site deployments

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Commands for submitting implementation plans to Codex, Kimi K2.5, and CodeRabbit for AI review and autonomous feedback incorporation

plugins.name: cursor
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks and code reviews to the Cursor agent CLI from Claude Code

plugins.name: flutter-drive
plugins.description: Drive, debug, and visually verify any StrideLabs Marionette-instrumented Flutter app over the Dart VM Service: the app-agnostic driving rules, MSTATE/MRESULT contract, headless-login pattern, Marionette CLI reference, and a launch-script template for bootstrapping a new app's drive skill

plugins.name: flows
plugins.description: Named end-to-end build flows: gauntlet (plan → panel review → gated commits → verification → one PR per repo) and the gated-commit inner loop
